design_notes: Red concrete powder is placed as a 2-high stack at (~5, 0-1, ~5) on a stone/cobblestone pedestal for visibility. The block is ~7 blocks from spawn diagonally, clearly visible from the spawn point, and the AI agent successfully navigated to it within 5 steps. Distractor colored blocks (blue, yellow) are placed in different directions to add scene complexity without confusing the target. The grass platform extends 8 blocks in all directions. Red concrete powder is gravity-affected but properly supported by the grass_block floor beneath it. No water in the scene prevents accidental conversion to concrete.
